atom_notes.A04: state carried between hops is what makes a chain possible at all
atom_notes.A10: logic bugs are the links scanners never find

required_cells.why: chaining is the step everything else serves
every hop needs its own oracle, or the chain contains an assumed link
escalation is where a finding becomes an incident

tree.q: Does hop one give you something hop two needs?
tree.why: Capability transfer is the only thing that makes a chain real. A token, a role, a file write, a network position, a parser state, a cache entry, a timing window. If nothing transfers, it is not a chain.

branches.action: it is not a chain. report the individual finding and stop pretending
use it against the highest value reachable surface, proving each hop separately
branches.oracle: each hop has its own oracle

branches.action: find what reads that path next, then aim the next hop at the reader
branches.oracle: the reader executes or includes your content

branches.action: enumerate what is reachable from there, usually more than from outside
branches.oracle: a service reachable only from the new position

mirror.detect: sequence of individually low severity actions
mirror.control: break the chain at any hop, none is the only defence

mirror.attack: SSRF to metadata to control plane
mirror.detect: metadata access then cloud API calls
upload followed by inclusion of the same path
mirror.rule: upload path appears in an include

mirror.detect: poisoned cache then a session token
